A jade seal binds each identity to one device. Daily a pulse comes at a random hour; the holder has two hours to answer with the seal and proof of one task that day. Three verifiers check the seal in the cedar registry, listing each seal once; a seal used twice or a missed pulse burns the $6 bond and ends the identity. Faking a hundred identities costs $600 in burned bonds, and each fake must answer the pulse and pass the cedar registry daily.
